verdict.rationale: Zep is a memory/context-graph platform, not an agent or assistant that itself executes tasks via tools. The evidence shows Zep exposes MCP *servers* (Memory MCP Server, Graphiti MCP Server) so external agents can consume Zep's memory — the reverse of the story, which asks whether Zep itself can plug in external MCP servers to use their tools. This client-side agentic capability is not a fair axis for a memory infrastructure product.
